verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph provides an extensive, documented public API for driving Teams programmatically (channels, messages, chats, bots, webhooks), confirmed live via OData metadata and OAuth-gated endpoints, plus a CLI/toolkit for building agents against it. Missing for 10: independent developer corroboration of ease-of-use (one community comment notes the Graph/Azure stack is heavier than Slack's simple webhooks), and no OpenAPI/llms.txt discoverability at the docs site itself.
